name: Organic residue mulching

soft_risks.risk: In cool wet conditions mulch can depress yields through allelochemicals and slow soil warming
soft_risks.mitigation: Use thinner layers and mulch only in the dry season

soft_risks.risk: Crop residues compete with fodder, fuel and construction uses
soft_risks.mitigation: Mulch only the share of residue not needed as fodder, or grow a dedicated biomass strip

mechanism: A surface residue layer cuts evaporation and raindrop impact, holding moisture and feeding soil organisms as it breaks down.

region_variants.note: FAO notes a net SOC decline over time in semiarid environments where net primary productivity is too low to supply enough residue.
